hypothesis: A completed opening auction with dominant CL effort and matched MCL result can support branch-specific initiative continuation or absorption reversal when ownership is bounded by the next inventory transfer rather than searched from forward outcomes.

execution.entry: exact next one-minute MCL open after the frozen fifteen-minute auction closes
execution.contract_or_clock_discontinuity: flatten at the last valid matched-MCL close
execution.next_anchor_overlap: flatten incumbent at next entry open before any successor admission

frozen_semantic_owners.clock_state: No price stop; own the frozen initiative or absorption direction until its scheduled anchor cutoff.

native_structure.initiative: MCL intrabar invalidation at the completed auction midpoint.
native_structure.absorption: MCL intrabar invalidation at the completed auction extreme beyond the rejected boundary.

joint_close_invalidation.initiative: After entry, the first completed five-minute CL and MCL closes jointly through their own auction midpoints invalidates at the next MCL open.
joint_close_invalidation.absorption: After entry, the first completed five-minute CL and MCL closes jointly beyond their own rejected preceding-hour boundaries invalidates at the next MCL open.

discovery_selection.cohorts: every direction, initiative/absorption branch, Europe/US anchor, and high/low side must be represented and positive under both primary and stress cost
ranking_after_eligibility: highest stress PnL to intrabar drawdown
highest primary PnL to intrabar drawdown

validation_law.if_no_discovery_owner_passes: reject all three owners and never open validation outcomes
validation_law.if_one_owner_is_selected: open only that exact owner on sealed validation; all discovery gates must pass independently

controls.same_holds_inverted_direction: report only after an owner is lawfully selected; never selectable
controls.ungated_volume_count_control: remains count-only and cannot enter this lifecycle

prohibitions: no volume threshold or statistic sweep
no branch, anchor, side, direction, month, or regime router after outcomes
no live order or capital authority
downstream_hold_even_on_pass: missing July 2023 through August 2024 dated-contract history
native MCL liquidity, spread, margin, commission, roll, preview, restart, reconciliation, and shared-capital proof
